subject: test: fix broken autocomplete test (#30782)
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Reorders three Material imports after RxJS imports. It changes no dependency identity or executable assertion; preserve the retained legacy imports.

Initializes AutocompleteWithoutOptions with fixture.detectChanges before reading its trigger. Adopt the analogous missing regression through existing SimpleAutocomplete with empty arrays, initial detection and zero-option assertion; no fixture template is changed.
Formats the static ViewChild option and removes an EOF blank line in a modern private fixture. The retained fixture is not copied; preserve its existing declaration and template.

decision: The complete original has three hunks: import reordering, one initial detectChanges before reading the empty-options fixture trigger, and ViewChild/EOF whitespace. The meaningful initialization protects a real open/close-with-no-options regression, which was absent from the retained legacy file. Add the analogous owned case using the existing SimpleAutocomplete template, empty both backing/filtered state arrays, run initial detection, assert zero options, open, close without throwing, then destroy. The exact appended case and all previous bodies/templates are authenticated by the repair/context evidence. Keep existing imports, fixtures and selectors; cosmetic modern hunks require no change. Adapt the coverage and correct initialization order only. This source review does not claim that the new Angular case has executed.
